name: oberleaf
description: The open-source, local-first LaTeX suite with instant equation preview, side-by-side PDF rendering, and zero compute timeouts.

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001, 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.logs: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path logs/project.log) { Get-Content -Path logs/project.log -Wait -Tail 50 } else { Write-Host 'No logs found yet. Start the app first.' }"
